source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001]!

Thank you for checking in. I’ve now finished reviewing your article, and you did excellent work. The writing is strong, though the blog could be improved further by adding a little more storytelling—for example, engaging introductions that break up lengthy informational lists. My team and I left feedback in the article for you to review and incorporate through the relevant edits.

Once you’ve reviewed the comments and made the edits, we’ll be ready to send your test article to our client. We really appreciate the work you’ve done here, and I’m looking forward to receiving the revised version.

Fire&Spark feedback on the article: [URL_001]

Please reach out if you have any questions!

Thanks,
[CLIENT_NAME_001]
